author: reek
body: The single copy of the JS-bridge stub contract for browser apps built through the HTML plug. Each definition below is a Codex-typed signature for a function the plug's runtime provides in JavaScript. The plug skips these definitions at emit time and routes calls to the runtime; the bodies exist only to satisfy the type checker. The names are the contract: HtmlEmitter matches them in is-html-builtin, in order to bind a call site to the browser runtime. Adding a runtime primitive means adding the JS to HtmlEmitter, adding the stub here, and regenerating -- never copying stubs into an app chapter.

author: reek
body: `is-html-builtin` binds these four, and TheShimmeringPortal lists them as part of this contract, but no typed stub was ever written for them. A chapter that called one therefore could not compile, so every app that wanted them declared its own copy -- which is what the stub contract exists to prevent, and what the CDX3006 collisions between the app themes are. The signatures match the MAUI plug's stubs (`codex/plugs/maui/MauiStubs.codex`), which are the same contract for the other backend.
